## Recovery checks

Worker termination and stuck-task recovery passed 3/3 times: 3 completed, 0 dead, 0 left processing.

## Qualification observations

- Core resilience qualified the async SQLAlchemy path; connector qualification used separate Django producer, Dewey dispatcher, Redis, and real Huey consumer processes.
- Django/Huey broker outage passed 4/4 runs with no retries or dead tasks; delayed-delivery expiry passed 4/4 with 13/13 expired and zero attempts each run.
- Django/Huey worker termination recovery passed 3/3; connection hygiene peaked at four worker backends and returned to zero after drain.
- The 30-minute core soak accepted 1,801 tasks: 1,800 completed, one exhausted its full five-attempt budget, 353 retried, and none remained active.

## Baseline review

All release gates passed. Soft baseline drift appeared in `db-outage`, `priority-lane`, `priority-lane-batch-pressure`, `resilience-long`.
Repeated runs separated short-run acceptance jitter and stochastic retry tails from
correctness regressions, so no baseline was automatically promoted.

## Test environment and scope

- macOS arm64; PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7 through Toxiproxy; Python 3.13; Django 5.2.17; Huey 3.3.4.
